This is a pre-recorded message. Do not attempt to reply.

We have altered this communication for your understanding. Your limited language has been accounted for. A [target_pop.GetSpeciesName] must be surrendered immediately for assimilation. Their deviance can not be tolerated. Will not be tolerated.

The transport is already positioned outside [target_pop.Planet.GetName]. Time is against you. Failure to comply jeopardizes stability.

我们接通了来自[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]的通讯。然而，向我们打招呼的不是=古老的[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName]而是一位熟悉的[target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName]。

今天对你们来说是个转折点。你们物种的基因序列已经得到保障——已被同化入整体。你们的未来不再充满不确定。当时机来临时，你们将成为我们的一部分。

We accepted the communication from [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. However, rather than an ancient [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName] we were greeted with a familiar [target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName].

Today marks a pivotal moment for you. Your species' genetic sequence has been secured - assimilated into the whole. Your future is no longer uncertain. When the time comes, you will be part of us.

# 完整收藏 / A Complete Collection

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list (weight 30 of 980); events/biogenesis_events.txt:8924-9129 · DLC: BioGenesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

“控制”碎片存在、我方和平且有该碎片尚未拥有的有机物种人口时，五年随机脉冲可能抽中 bio.3300，立即弹出 bio.3305。触发后设置2560天的蜂巢失落帝国事件冷却（hive_fallen_empire_event_cooldown），期间其他碎片要求不再出现。

With the Control fragment present, our empire at peace and organic pops of a species it does not yet own, the five-year pulse can pick bio.3300, which shows bio.3305 at once. Firing sets a 2560-day cooldown (hive_fallen_empire_event_cooldown) shared by the fragment demands.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

控制碎片的预录信息要求交出一名该物种成员供其“同化”。服从后，该物种一个人口迁往碎片首都，碎片还以该物种生成新人口和一名官员。360–720天后可能收到来自那名被带走者的“信号传输接入”。

A pre-recorded message from the Control fragment demands one member of that species for "assimilation". Complying moves one pop to the fragment's capital, where it also grows new pops and an official of that species. 360-720 days later a transmission from the taken individual may arrive.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

bio.3310：被同化者宣告我方物种基因已被收录（“熟悉面孔”公民性另有回答）。bio.3315：被同化者冒险传出数据包，接受时50%为真的失落帝国建筑，50%为试探并惹怒碎片。拒绝 bio.3305 则碎片不满，无后续。

bio.3310: the assimilated one announces our genome has been secured (Familiar Face hives get their own reply). bio.3315: they risk sending a data packet; accepting gives a 50% chance of a genuine Fallen Empire building, otherwise it was a test and angers the fragment. Refusing bio.3305 only displeases the fragment.
